'''Document:''' release-sheet slip; slip number “08” bottom right, the Virtual Block 4 set mark. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Janus Greejatus (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 4 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Once per turn, if at Death Star: Conference Room (V){{!}}Conference Room and you just drew a non-Epic Event destiny < your total Influence here, may use 2 Force to cancel and redraw that destiny or use 4 Force to add 2 to that destiny.” '''What changed:''' “your total influence here” is written “your total Influence here”, with a capital I. The same wording is already in the Holotable card data of 29 May 2010[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Holotable data, copy on GitHub). '''Decipher (Reflections II foil)''' — [[Echo Base Operations (Reflections II Foil)|Echo Base Operations (foil)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Effect: Echo Base Operations, Hoth, R2 |strategy=By Carl "Mike" Hardyhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/echobaseoperations.html Well, this card needs little introduction. I remember when I got my first Box of the [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]] expansion and got a look at this card. I thought, "Wow, I wonder if I could make this work...." Well, I read into it and decided that it would simply be too hard to make happen and frankly kind of susceptible to more "specialized" decks. Boy, was I wrong! A few months later the [[Echo Base Operations]] (EBO) deck burst onto the scene. It was fast, it was tough, and it was nearly unstoppable! To be honest, I believe this card to be the second most powerful non-character card in the game (second only to the quite effective, and dreaded, [[Scanning Crew]]). Here's how it works. To most effectively use EBO you've got to get the necessary sites on the table. This can be made easier if you have two of each of these needed sites. Also, have plenty of System Location through which to drain from. The main idea isn't to battle - don't let that "+3 in battle" fool you. The most efficient EBO decks I've seen have only Y-wings (which deploy for nothing with EBO in place) and protective interrupts like [[Hyper Escape]] or [[Houjix]]. Once the Dark Side commits to an action with EBO going, you'll be able to drain your dark opponent out of the game before he can mount another such action. : *Echo Base Command Center + Droid + How Did We Get Into This Mess = You can go through your deck and get everything you need in only a couple of turns. This makes an otherwise slow EBO deck, insanely fast! *EBO + [[Kessel]] + 3 Y-wings + [[Y-wing Assault Squadron]] = With EBO running you can deploy the Y-wings for nothing at [[Kessel]] and replace them with the Squadron. Your drains are now 5 at [[Kessel]]! Few cards can get you that kind of game-impacting potential! : 9.5 (I would have given it a 10 except for the fact that by and large EBO decks are suceptible to Monnock.) |combos=* [[Echo Base Operations]] + Echo Base Command Center + any Droid + [[How Did We Get Into This Mess?]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Echo%20Base%20Operations Scomp: Echo Base Operations]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive] * [[Echo Base Operations]] + [[Kessel]] + 3 Y-wings + [[Y-wing Assault Squadron]] |pulled_by=* [[A New Secret Base]] * [[The Signal]] * [[We Wish To Board At Once]] * [[Wokling (V)]] |also_known_as=* EBO |has_refs=1 }}

'''Card text:''' Deploy on Main Power Generators if you occupy at least three Echo sites. At every system location, your deploy cost is -1, your Force drains are +2, and your total power is +2 in battles. Canceled if the opponent occupies five Hoth sites. Not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' After the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance began to receive aid from systems ready to rise against the Empire. Echo Base is the command base that puts that aid to efficient use. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds total power +2 in battles; the English adds +3. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Echo Base Operations]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103.
